answers.value: Issued life underwriting files ready for closure; scope = one policy's underwriting file (POL-####) closed after issue and delivery, in the policy admin system and OpenText.
Post-issue: the file is closed once the policy is issued/delivered and all outstanding requirements are cleared, within the case-closure SLA (e.g. 5 business days after delivery).
Policy number, issue date, delivery confirmation, outstanding-requirement status and closure reason are populated; any open requirement or missing delivery confirmation prevents closure.
Count of open requirements at closure equals zero (or each remaining item has a documented post-issue disposition); the file's checklist reconciles to fully cleared.
The closed underwriting file (decision summary, evidence index, delivery receipt) is archived in OpenText /UW/<policy-no>/ with closure timestamp and version; retained per retention schedule.
Any item remaining open at closure is logged as an exception with disposition (post-issue delivery requirement / reopen / waive with approval) and reason before the file is marked closed.
The underwriting decision and premium were set under the approved/filed methodology and rate-table version; the version is recorded in the file before closure.
Not model-driven at closure; closure applies a completeness check rather than a sensitivity analysis, so sensitivity thresholds are not applicable beyond confirming inputs were within filed ranges.
Materiality for closure: any open mandatory requirement is material and blocks closure; only non-material administrative items may carry a documented post-issue disposition.
The closed file traces to the underwriting decision, premium worksheet, and delivery receipt in the policy admin system; the closure record links the archived evidence index.
File status moves to 'Closed' only when policy status is Issued/Delivered and all mandatory requirements are cleared; premature closure is blocked.
Closure date is on/after issue and delivery dates; issue, delivery and closure dates are recorded and consistent.
